scope: Read-only visual airframe seam audit of native B; ten fresh Blender Workbench endpoint views plus four existing real baseline renders. No geometry edits or new Blend saved. No browser test. All dimensions are uncalibrated concept units u.

abnormal_discontinuities.item: Moving wing root front blue/white notch and rear S-shaped recess
abnormal_discontinuities.status: Confirmed visible; already assigned to wing-edge repair worker. Not duplicated here.

abnormal_discontinuities.item: Blue leading coating butt step at |X|=1.03, both sides
abnormal_discontinuities.status: Additional confirmed non-motion exterior step; not a through-hole. Underlying body changes to blue material near root while outer wing retains an offset coating mesh, leaving a hard raised ring. Recommend local flush/tapered transition only, rather than sealing any mechanism gap.
abnormal_discontinuities.witness: Nose outward offset 0.003999710u on both sides; sampled upper-surface offset L=0.004038155u, R=0.004117653u. These are local section witnesses, not global maximums.

reasonable_assembly_lines.area: Forward cargo hood perimeter and paired latches
reasonable_assembly_lines.judgment: Closed assembled shell joint with documented stepped seam profile, separate opening lip and hinge. Curved/lower stepped seam is intentional, not a torn fuselage opening. Do not merge hood into hull.

reasonable_assembly_lines.area: Dorsal hatch, fixed-root access covers and wing service panels
reasonable_assembly_lines.judgment: Consistent rounded closed outlines with no observed isolated missing corner or accidental notch in reviewed views. Preserve service boundaries.

reasonable_assembly_lines.area: Nacelle longitudinal U access lines, cowl boundary and wing saddle seams
reasonable_assembly_lines.judgment: Four repeated motor pod assemblies show consistent mating edges. No additional through-opening or detached wing-to-pod connection confirmed from upper/lower/hover views. Keep two short saddle joins and U-shaped access outlines.

reasonable_assembly_lines.area: Tail boom circumferential join and V-tail roots
reasonable_assembly_lines.judgment: Visible silhouette and root surface are continuous in reviewed views; dark triangular tail surface is shaded geometry, not evidence of a new gap.

necessary_motion_clearances.area: Fixed-to-moving oblique wing root skin and hinge axis aperture
necessary_motion_clearances.judgment: Visible cruise crescent, overlap relief and axis access must not be sealed as ordinary cracks. Existing source documentation gives maximum upper-skin projected X aperture about 0.06891u and supplied prior 116.4deg occupation witness. This audit does not rerun or strengthen that finite-motion proof.

necessary_motion_clearances.area: Wing and V-tail movable control surfaces
necessary_motion_clearances.judgment: Straight trailing hinge lines and narrow end reliefs align with separate control surfaces. Preserve fold/deflection separation.

necessary_motion_clearances.area: Spinner-to-cowl interface and blade folding forks
necessary_motion_clearances.judgment: Annular separation and fork windows have actual spindle/pin geometry, not detached floating parts. Preserve rotational and folding clearance. No additional accidental break confirmed.

limitations: Ten fresh renders are at 0deg cruise and 120deg hover endpoints. They do not establish every continuous pose, minimum clearance, watertight assembly, strength or manufacturability.
Gray Workbench review favors shape and seams; this is not browser/GPU runtime validation.
No additional confirmed defect outside the root outline issues and coating butt step was found in the specifically reviewed regions; this is not an exhaustive no-defect proof.
